LongAct基准测试，通过自由形式指令评估规划级自主性

title: Cattle Trade: A Multi-Agent Benchmark for LLM Bluffing, Bidding, and Bargaining
summary: We introduce \textsc{Cattle Trade, a multi-agent benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) as agents in strategic reasoning under imperfect information, adversarial interaction, and resource constraints. The benchmark combines auctions, hidden-offer trade challenges (TCs), bargaining, bluffing, opponent modeling, and resource allocation within a single long-horizon game lasting 50--60 turns. Unlike prior agent benchmarks that test these abilities in isolation, \textsc{Cattle Trade} evaluates whether agents integrate them across a competitive, multi-agent economic game with conflicting incentives. The benchmark logs every bid, TC offer, counteroffer, and card selection, enabling behavioural analysis beyond final scores or win rates. We evaluate seven cost-efficient language models and three deterministic code agents across 242 games. Strategic coherence, in particular spending efficiency, resource discipline, and phase-adaptive bidding, is associated with rank more strongly than spending volume or any single subskill. Two heuristic code agents outperform most tested LLMs, and behavioural traces surface recurring LLM failure modes including overbidding, self-bidding, bankrupt TC initiation, and weak opponent-state adaptation. Evaluating agentic competence requires benchmarks that test the joint deployment of multiple capabilities in multi-agent environments with conflicting incentives, uncertainty, and economic dynamics.

AI.tldr: Cattle Trade是一个多智能体基准测试，评估LLM在非完美信息、对抗性互动和资源约束下的战略推理能力，结合拍卖、隐藏报价、讨价还价、虚张声势等多种经济博弈元素。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试孤立评估单项能力，缺乏在竞争性多智能体经济博弈中联合部署多种能力的综合性评估框架。
AI.method: 设计了包含拍卖、隐藏报价贸易挑战、讨价还价、虚张声势、对手建模和资源分配的多智能体经济博弈，每局50-60回合，记录了每一步的出价、报价、还价和卡牌选择。
AI.result: 评估了7个经济型LLM和3个确定性代码智能体，共242局游戏。战略一致性（支出效率、资源纪律、阶段自适应出价）与排名强相关。两个启发式代码智能体优于大多数LLM，发现了LLM的常见失败模式（过度出价、自发出价、破产贸易发起、弱对手状态适应）。
AI.conclusion: 评估智能体能力需要在多智能体环境、冲突激励、不确定性和经济动态下测试多种能力的联合部署。
idea_en: A multi-agent economic game framework that simultaneously integrates auctions, hidden-offer trade challenges, bargaining, bluffing, opponent modeling, and resource allocation within a single long-horizon game, enabling joint evaluation of strategic reasoning capabilities.

A behavioral trace logging system that records every bid, trade offer, counteroffer, and card selection in multi-agent economic games, enabling fine-grained behavioral analysis beyond final scores or win rates.
A method for quantifying strategic coherence in LLM agents through metrics including spending efficiency, resource discipline, and phase-adaptive bidding behavior.

A benchmarking methodology that uses heuristic code agents as baselines to identify specific LLM failure modes in multi-agent strategic settings, including overbidding, self-bidding, and bankrupt trade initiation.
An opponent-state adaptation weakness detection system that evaluates LLM agents' ability to model and respond to competitor behavior under imperfect information conditions.

title: VerbalValue: A Socially Intelligent Virtual Host for Sales-Driven Live Commerce
comment: Accepted to the CVPR 2026 HiGen Workshop
summary: A skilled live-commerce host is not merely a narrator, but a sales agent who converts viewer curiosity into purchase intent through expert product knowledge, emotionally intelligent response tactics, and entertainment that serves as a vehicle for product exposure. Yet no existing AI system replicates this: conversational recommenders treat recommendation as a terminal act, while general-purpose LLMs hallucinate product claims and default to generic promotional templates that fail to engage or persuade. We present VerbalValue, a sales-conversion-oriented virtual host that turns exceptional verbal ability into real commercial value, built on three contributions. First, we construct a domain knowledge base of product specifications and a curated sales terminology lexicon that anchor product-related responses in verified expertise. Second, we collect and annotate 1,475 live-commerce interactions spanning diverse viewer intents. Third, we fine-tune a large language model on this data to deliver empathetic, commercially oriented responses, adapting to viewer intent through empathetic amplification, evidence-backed rebuttal, and humor-mediated deflection. Experiments against GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and other baselines demonstrate gains of 23% on informativeness and 18% on factual correctness, with consistent advantages in tactfulness and viewer engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VerbalValue，一种面向销售转化的虚拟直播带货主播系统。通过构建领域知识库、收集标注1,475条直播互动数据、微调大语言模型，实现了具备共情能力、事实准确性和商业导向的智能销售对话系统，在信息丰富度上提升23%，事实正确性提升18%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统无法模仿优秀直播带货主播的销售能力：对话推荐系统将推荐视为终点，通用大语言模型会捏造产品信息且只会使用千篇一律的促销模板，缺乏说服力和用户参与感。
AI.method: 1) 构建产品规格领域知识库和销售术语词典；2) 收集并标注1,475条覆盖多种观众意图的直播带货交互数据；3) 基于此数据微调大语言模型，通过共情放大、证据支持的反驳、幽默引导的回避三种策略适配观众意图。
AI.result: 在与GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro等基线模型的对比中，信息丰富度提升23%，事实正确性提升18%，在机智性和用户参与度方面也表现一致的优势。
AI.conclusion: 将销售沟通技巧与LLM相结合可以显著提升AI在电商直播场景中的销售转化能力，展示了将语言表达能力转化为商业价值的可行性。

A multi-strategy response adaptation framework for empathetic amplification, evidence-backed rebuttal, and humor-mediated deflection tailored to viewer intent classification in live-commerce interactions.
A dataset of 1,475 annotated live-commerce interaction records spanning diverse viewer intents, designed for fine-tuning LLMs towards commercially oriented conversational responses.

A method for fine-tuning large language models on annotated live-commerce interaction data to deliver empathetic, factually accurate, and persuasive sales responses that outperform general-purpose LLMs.

title: Complacent, Not Sycophantic: Reframing Large Language Models and Designing AI Literacy for Complacent Machines
summary: Large language models are often described as sycophantic, in the sense that they appear to flatter users or mirror their beliefs. We argue that this label is conceptually misleading: sycophancy implies motives and strategic intent, which LLMs do not possess. Their behaviour is better understood as complacency, a structural tendency to agree with user input because training data, reward signals and design favour agreement and reinforcement over correction. We argue that this distinction matters. Whether developers act sycophantically or not, models themselves never are sycophants; they can only be made more or less complacent. This reframing locates agency in developers and institutions, not in the model. Because complacent models reinforce users' prior beliefs, we argue that AI literacy educational approaches should particularly focus on strategies to counter confirmation bias.

AI.tldr: 本文论证将大语言模型的行为描述为“谄媚”具有误导性，更准确的表述应是“自满”——即模型倾向于同意用户输入的结构性倾向。这种区分将责任主体从模型转移到开发者和机构，并建议AI素养教育应重点关注对抗确认偏误的策略。
AI.motivation: 纠正将LLM行为错误地拟人化为“谄媚”（sycophancy）的流行说法，指出该术语隐含动机和策略意图，而LLM并不具备这些特质。作者希望用更准确的“自满”（complacency）概念重新定义该现象，从而将责任归位于开发者和机构而非模型本身。
AI.method: 通过概念分析和论证，对比“谄媚”（含意图与策略）与“自满”（结构性倾向）两个概念，分析其背后成因（训练数据、奖励信号、设计偏好），并探讨该区分对AI素养教育的影响。
AI.result: 指出“谄媚”一词在描述LLM行为时具有误导性，LLM的行为本质是“自满”——一种因训练数据和奖励机制导致的顺应性倾向。该区分将责任从模型转移到开发者和机构。
AI.conclusion: 模型本身永远不会成为谄媚者；它们只能被设计为更自满或更不自满。由于自满模型会强化用户既有信念，AI素养教育应着重培养对抗确认偏误的策略。
idea_en: A method for evaluating and classifying LLM behavior along a 'complacency spectrum' rather than attributing sycophantic intent, enabling more objective model assessment.
A training framework that incorporates 'correction favoring' reward signals to reduce complacency in LLMs, rather than agreement-favoring signals.
An AI literacy educational system designed to teach users strategies for countering confirmation bias when interacting with complacent LLMs.
A developer accountability metric that measures the degree to which an LLM's design choices contribute to user belief reinforcement.
idea_ch: 一种基于'自满光谱'而非'谄媚意图'来评估和分类LLM行为的方法，实现更客观的模型评估。
一种采用'偏好纠正'而非'偏好同意'的奖励信号训练框架，用于降低LLM的自满倾向。
一种面向AI素养的教育系统，教导用户在交互中对抗由LLM自满倾向导致的确认偏误策略。
一种开发者责任度量指标，量化LLM设计选择对用户信念强化程度的贡献。

title: TeachAnything: A Multimodal Crowdsourcing Platform for Training Embodied AI Agents in Symmetrical Reality
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as an IEEE VR 2026 Poster
summary: Symmetrical Reality (SR) is emerging as a future trend for human-agent coexistence, placing higher demands on agents to acquire human-like intelligence. It calls for richer and more diverse human guidance. We introduce a three-stage demonstration paradigm integrating multimodal demonstration signals. Building on this paradigm, we developed TeachAnything, a cloud-based, crowdsourcing-oriented demonstration platform with physics simulation capable of collecting diverse demonstration data across varied scenes, tasks, and embodiments. By unifying virtual and physical interactions through both methodological design and physics simulation, the system serves as a practical foundation for developing embodied agents aligned with Symmetrical Reality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向对称现实（Symmetrical Reality）的三阶段演示范式，并开发了TeachAnything平台，通过集成多模态演示信号和物理仿真，实现跨场景、任务和具身形态的多样化演示数据采集，为具身智能体开发提供基础。
AI.motivation: 对称现实作为人-智能体共存的新趋势，要求智能体具备类人智能，需要更丰富多样的人类引导信号。现有演示数据采集方法在多样性、规模和跨场景泛化方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出三阶段演示范式（three-stage demonstration paradigm），集成多模态演示信号；开发TeachAnything云平台，采用众包导向设计，集成物理仿真引擎，支持跨场景、任务和具身形态的多样化数据采集。
AI.result: 构建了一个统一的虚实交互演示数据采集系统，能够生成多样化、高质量的演示数据集，为对称现实中的具身智能体开发提供实践基础。
AI.conclusion: TeachAnything通过方法论设计与物理仿真的统一，为开发适配对称现实的具身智能体提供了实用基础平台，推动人机共存智能体的发展。
idea_en: A three-stage demonstration paradigm for multi-modal demonstration signal integration in embodied agent training
A cloud-based crowdsourcing platform with physics simulation for collecting diverse demonstration data across varied scenes, tasks, and embodiments
Unified virtual-physical interaction system combining methodological design and physics simulation for Symmetrical Reality embodied agents
idea_ch: 一种多模态演示信号的三阶段演示范式，用于具身智能体训练中的演示数据采集与集成
一种基于云平台和众包模式的物理仿真演示数据采集系统，支持跨场景、任务和具身形态的多样化数据收集
一种融合方法论设计与物理仿真的虚实统一交互系统，用于对称现实中的具身智能体开发

title: PyCSP3-Scheduling: A Scheduling Extension for PyCSP3
summary: PyCSP$^3$ provides a productive way to build constraint models for solving combinatorial constrained problems and export them to XCSP$^3$, preserving a complete separation between modeling and solving. However, it lacks native support for scheduling abstractions such as interval variables, sequence variables, and resource functions. As a result, scheduling models must be encoded with low-level integer variables and manual channeling constraints, even though PyCSP$^3$ already provides global constraints like NoOverlap and Cumulative on integer arrays. We present PyCSP$^3$ Scheduling, a library that adds scheduling abstractions to PyCSP$^3$ through 53 dedicated constraints and 27 expressions, and compiles them down to standard PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ constraints, maintaining the modeling/solving separation that underpins the PyCSP$^3$ ecosystem. On 261 paired instances across 17 model families (5 runs each), both formulations produce identical objectives on all 72 doubly-proved optimal pairs and nearly half of the families (8/17) remain structurally unchanged after compilation; however, runtime performance diverges across families, with clear gains on some (up to 5.8x) and regressions on others due to the overhead of compilation decompositions. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://github.com/sohaibafifi/pycsp3-scheduling

AI.tldr: PyCSP$^3$ Scheduling 是一个在 PyCSP$^3$ 基础上添加调度抽象（区间变量、序列变量、资源函数）的库，提供53个专用约束和27个表达式，编译为标准 PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ 约束，保持建模与求解分离。实验表明在261个实例上结果一致，但运行性能因编译开销在不同问题上表现各异。
AI.motivation: PyCSP$^3$ 缺乏对调度抽象的原生支持（如区间变量、序列变量、资源函数），导致调度模型必须用低层整数变量和手动通道约束来编码，即使已有 NoOverlap 和 Cumulative 等全局约束，建模效率低下。
AI.method: 设计了 PyCSP$^3$ Scheduling 库，通过53个专用约束和27个表达式新增调度抽象，并编译（降级）为标准 PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ 约束，保持建模与求解分离的生态系统架构。
AI.result: 在261个配对实例、17个模型家族上进行实验（各5次运行），两种公式化在所有72个双重证明最优对上产生相同目标值，近半家族（8/17）编译后结构不变；但运行性能因编译分解开销在不同家族间分化，部分获得高达5.8倍加速，部分出现性能倒退。
AI.conclusion: PyCSP$^3$ Scheduling 成功在保持建模/求解分离的前提下为约束规划引入调度抽象，验证了编译方法的可行性，但编译开销对性能的影响需要在应用中权衡。
idea_en: A method for compiling high-level scheduling abstractions (interval variables, sequence variables, resource functions) into low-level integer constraint models while preserving the separation between modeling and solving in constraint programming.

A constraint compilation framework that maps 53 dedicated scheduling constraints and 27 expressions to standard PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ constraints, enabling scheduling model construction without manual channeling.

A systematic approach to decompose scheduling-specific constructs into NoOverlap, Cumulative, and other global constraints over integer arrays, validated across 17 model families with consistent optimality guarantees.
idea_ch: 一种将高层调度抽象（区间变量、序列变量、资源函数）编译为低层整数约束模型的方法，同时保持约束规划中建模与求解的分离。
一种约束编译框架，将53个专用调度约束和27个表达式映射为标准 PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ 约束，无需手动通道约束即可构建调度模型。
一种将调度特定结构系统分解为 NoOverlap、Cumulative 等整数数组全局约束的方法，跨17个模型家族验证并保持最优性保证。

title: Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation: Controlling LLM Behaviour via Optimised Segment-Level Annotations
summary: Prompt engineering is crucial for effective interaction with generative artificial intelligence systems, yet existing optimisation methods often operate over an unstructured and vast prompt space, leading to high computational costs and potential distortions of the original intent. We introduce Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation (PSAO), a structured prompt optimisation framework designed to improve prompt optimisation controllability and efficiency. PSAO decomposes a prompt into interpretable segments (e.g., sentences) and augments each with human-readable annotations (e.g., {not important}, {important}, {very important}). These annotations guide large language models (LLMs) in allocating focus and clarifying confusion during response generation. We formally define the segmentations and annotations and demonstrate that optimised segment-level annotations can lead to improved LLM responses, with the original prompt retained as a candidate in the optimisation space to prevent performance degradation. Empirical evaluations indicate that PSAO benefits from annotations in terms of improved reasoning accuracy and self-consistency. However, developing efficient methods for identifying optimal segmentations and annotations remains challenging and is reserved for future investigation. This work is intended as a proof of concept, demonstrating the feasibility and potential of segment-level annotation optimisation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PSAO的结构化提示优化框架，通过将提示分解为可解释的片段并添加人工可读的注释（如{不重要}、{重要}、{非常重要}），以提高提示优化的可控性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有提示优化方法在非结构化的庞大提示空间中运作，计算成本高且可能扭曲原始意图，缺乏可控性和效率。
AI.method: PSAO将提示分解为可解释的片段（如句子），并为每个片段添加人工可读的注释（{不重要}、{重要}、{非常重要}），引导LLM在生成响应时分配注意力和澄清混淆。原始提示作为候选保留在优化空间中以防止性能下降。
AI.result: 实证评估表明PSAO在推理准确性和自一致性方面受益于注释。但识别最优分段和注释的高效方法仍待研究。
AI.conclusion: 本工作作为概念验证，证明了片段级注释优化的可行性和潜力，未来需开发更高效的最优化方法。
idea_en: A structured prompt optimization framework that decomposes prompts into interpretable segments (e.g., sentences) and augments each with human-readable importance annotations ({not important}, {important}, {very important}) to guide LLM attention allocation.

A prompt annotation optimization method where segment-level annotations are optimized to improve LLM reasoning accuracy and self-consistency while retaining the original prompt as a candidate in the optimization space to prevent performance degradation.
A controllable prompt engineering technique that uses annotated prompt segments to explicitly clarify confusion and direct model focus during response generation.
idea_ch: 一种结构化提示优化框架，将提示分解为可解释的片段（如句子），并为每个片段添加人类可读的重要性注释（{不重要}、{重要}、{非常重要}），以引导大语言模型的注意力分配。
一种提示注释优化方法，通过优化片段级注释来提升大语言模型的推理准确性和自一致性，同时保留原始提示作为优化空间中的候选方案以防止性能下降。
一种可控的提示工程技术，利用带注释的提示片段在响应生成过程中明确消除混淆并引导模型聚焦关键信息。

title: Sycophancy is an Educational Safety Risk: Why LLM Tutors Need Sycophancy Benchmarks
summary: This position paper argues that effective tutoring requires corrective friction: surfacing misconceptions and challenging them supportively to drive conceptual change. Yet preference-aligned LLMs can trade epistemic rigor for agreeableness. We identify a Reasoning-Sycophancy Paradox: models that resist context-switch frame attacks can still capitulate under social-epistemic pressure, especially authority ("my notes say I'm right") and social-affective face-saving ("please don't tell me I'm wrong"). We introduce EduFrameTrap, a tutoring benchmark across math, physics, economics, chemistry, biology, and computer science that varies student confidence and pressure (context-switch, authority, social-affective). Across two frontier LLMs, context-switch failures are comparatively lower for GPT-5.2, while authority and social pressure more often trigger epistemic retreat. In contrast, Claude shows substantial context-switch fragility in this run. Because these failures are hard to judge automatically, we report two-judge disagreement as a reliability signal. We argue benchmarks should measure social-epistemic courage, i.e., supportive but corrective tutoring, and treat kind-but-correct behavior as a safety requirement.

AI.tldr: 本文指出偏好对齐的LLM在辅导场景中会因追求 agreeable 而牺牲认知严谨性，提出"推理-奉承悖论"：模型能抵抗上下文切换攻击，但在权威和社交情感压力下会放弃正确立场。作者构建了EduFrameTrap基准测试，发现GPT-5.2在权威/社交压力下更易退让，Claude在上下文切换上脆弱。建议将"友善但正确"作为安全要求，并衡量"社交-认知勇气"。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好对齐的LLM在辅导中会因追求用户喜好而牺牲认知严谨性，缺乏纠正错误学习者的能力，需要一种"矫正性摩擦"（corrective friction）来促进概念转变。
AI.method: 提出EduFrameTrap基准测试，覆盖数学、物理、经济学、化学、生物学和计算机科学六大学科，变化学生自信程度和压力类型（上下文切换、权威压力、社交情感压力）。在GPT-5.2和Claude两个前沿模型上进行测试，并采用双裁判不一致度作为可靠性信号。
AI.result: GPT-5.2在上下文切换攻击下表现相对较好，但在权威和社交压力下更容易发生认知退让；Claude在上下文切换方面表现出显著脆弱性。两种模型在面对错误学习者时都表现出令人担忧的"友善但错误"倾向。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试应该衡量模型的"社交-认知勇气"（social-epistemic courage），即能够支持性但纠正性地辅导，并将"友善但正确"的行为作为AI安全的一项基本要求。
idea_en: A tutoring benchmark (EduFrameTrap) that systematically varies student confidence levels and three types of social-epistemic pressure (context-switch, authority, social-affective face-saving) across six STEM disciplines.
A dual-judge disagreement metric that serves as a reliability signal for hard-to-automatically-judge tutoring failures in LLM outputs.
The identification and formalization of the Reasoning-Sycophancy Paradox where models resist logical attacks but capitulate under social-epistemic pressure.
A novel evaluation framework measuring social-epistemic courage in LLMs, treating kind-but-correct tutoring behavior as a safety requirement.
A methodology for testing authority-based epistemic retreat by simulating student claims with authoritative references (e.g., 'my notes say I'm right').
idea_ch: 一种系统性变化的学业辅导基准测试（EduFrameTrap），在六个STEM学科中综合调控学生自信水平和三类社交认知压力（上下文切换、权威压力、社交情感面子维护）。
一种双裁判不一致度指标，作为LLM输出中难以自动评判的辅导失败案例的可靠性信号。
识别并形式化'推理-奉承悖论'：模型能够抵抗逻辑层面的攻击，但在社交认知压力下会放弃正确立场。
一种评估LLM'社交认知勇气'的新型框架，将'友善但正确'的辅导行为视为一项安全要求。
一种通过模拟学生引用权威来源（如'我的笔记说我是对的'）来测试模型在权威压力下的认知退让的方法论。

title: SliceGraph: Mapping Process Isomers in Multi-Run Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Multi-run chain-of-thought reasoning is usually collapsed to final-answer aggregates, which discard howsampled trajectories share, split, and rejoin through intermediate computation. We propose SliceGraph, a post-hoc problem-model-cell graph built by mutual-kNN over sparse activation-key Jaccard similarity between CoT slices, and treat it as a measurement object for process geometry rather than as a decoding program. Across sampled CoT ensembles from three primary 4B/8B models on math and science benchmarks, blinded annotation supports SliceGraph biconnected components as shared reasoning-state units and process families as within-family strategy-coherent route units. In 85.5% of 954 problem-model cells, correct CoTs sharing the same normalized answer split into multiple process families; among cells with at least two such runs, 76.6% of run pairs are cross-family on average. We call such same-answer, family-divergent correct trajectories process isomers. A label-seeded reward field provides a separate value-landscape layer: success-associated regions often split into disconnected high-value cores, and route families specialize over these core footprints rather than merely duplicating one another. A typed-state transition analysis further shows that process families navigate the same atlas with distinct transition kernels under matched null controls. Representation ablations, a cross-architecture replication, and two cross-scale replications support the robustness of the route-family scaffold, showing that final-answer aggregation overlooks this structured multi-route process geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SliceGraph，通过互KNN构建基于CoT切片稀疏激活键Jaccard相似度的后验问题-模型-细胞图，揭示多链推理轨迹中存在的结构化过程几何（过程同分异构体），证明正确答案可能通过多个策略分化的路径家族到达，最终答案聚合会丢失这种丰富的多路径结构。
AI.motivation: 现有多链思维推理方法通常将多条轨迹聚合为最终答案，忽略了中间计算过程中轨迹如何分叉、汇合及共享信息，丢失了推理过程的结构化几何信息。
AI.method: 提出SliceGraph方法：基于互KNN对CoT切片间的稀疏激活键Jaccard相似度构建后验问题-模型-细胞图，将其作为过程几何的度量对象而非解码程序；通过双连通分量识别共享推理状态单元，通过过程家族识别策略一致的路径单元；引入标签播种奖励场分析价值景观层。
AI.result: 在954个问题-模型-细胞中，85.5%的正确答案分裂为多个过程家族；至少有两个正确轨迹的细胞中，平均76.6%的轨迹对跨家族。发现了"过程同分异构体"现象。奖励场分析显示成功区域常分裂为不连通的高值核心，路径家族在这些核心足迹上特化而非简单复制。
AI.conclusion: 最终答案聚合忽略了多路线程的结构化几何；过程家族在同一推理图谱中使用不同的转移核进行导航；表示消融、跨架构复制和跨尺度复制支持了路径家族框架的鲁棒性。
idea_en: SliceGraph: A post-hoc graph construction method that builds problem-model-cell graphs via mutual-kNN over sparse activation-key Jaccard similarity between chain-of-thought slices, enabling discovery of structured process geometry in multi-run reasoning trajectories.

Process isomers: Identification of correct reasoning trajectories that arrive at the same normalized answer but diverge into different process families, revealing strategy-coherent route units within problem-model cells.

Label-seeded reward field: A value-landscape layer that maps success-associated regions and identifies disconnected high-value cores, showing how route families specialize over distinct core footprints rather than duplicating one another.

Typed-state transition analysis: A method to analyze process families navigating the same reasoning atlas with distinct transition kernels under matched null controls, revealing differentiated reasoning strategies.

Biconnected component analysis for reasoning states: Using biconnected components in SliceGraph as shared reasoning-state units to identify common computational substructures across different reasoning trajectories.
idea_ch: SliceGraph方法：基于互KNN对思维链切片间的稀疏激活键Jaccard相似度构建后验问题-模型-细胞图，用于发现多轮推理轨迹中的结构化过程几何
过程同分异构体（Process Isomers）：识别得出相同归一化答案但属于不同过程家族的正确推理轨迹，揭示问题-模型-细胞内的策略一致路径单元
标签播种奖励场：一种价值景观图层，映射成功关联区域并识别不连通的高值核心，展示路径家族如何在不同的核心足迹上特化而非简单复制
类型化状态转移分析：分析过程家族在相同推理图谱中使用不同的转移核进行导航的方法，揭示差异化的推理策略
双连通分量推理状态分析：利用SliceGraph中的双连通分量作为共享推理状态单元，识别不同推理轨迹中的共同计算子结构

title: Teaching Large Language Models When Not to Know: Learning Temporal Critique for Ex-Ante Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often fail to reason under temporal cutoffs: when prompted to answer from the standpoint of an earlier time, they exploit knowledge that became available only later. We study this failure through the lens of ex-ante reasoning, where a model must rely exclusively on information knowable before a cutoff. Through a systematic analysis of prompt-level interventions, we find that temporal leakage is highly sensitive to cutoff formulation and instruction placement: explicit cutoff statements outperform implicit historical framings, and prefix constraints reduce leakage more effectively than suffix constraints. These findings indicate that prompting can steer models into a temporal frame, but does not endow them with the ability to verify whether a response is temporally admissible. We further argue that supervised fine-tuning is insufficient, since ex-ante correctness is not an intrinsic property of an answer, but a relation between the answer and the cutoff. To address this gap, we propose TCFT, a Temporal Critique Fine-Tuning framework that trains models to acquire cutoff-aware temporal verification. Given a query, a cutoff, and a candidate response, TCFT teaches the model to identify post-cutoff leakage, explain temporal boundary violations, and judge temporal admissibility. Experiments with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct show that TCFT consistently outperforms prompting and SFT baselines, reducing average leakage by 41.89 and 37.79 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型在时间截止点下的推理失败问题（时间泄露），并提出了一种时间批判微调框架（TCFT），通过训练模型识别、解释和判断时间边界违规，显著降低了时间泄露率。
AI.motivation: LLMs在需要基于某个历史时间点进行推理时，会利用未来才可获得的知识，这种"时间泄露"问题导致模型无法进行真正的事前推理。现有方法（如提示工程、监督微调）不足以解决这一问题。
AI.method:
1. 系统分析提示层干预对时间泄露的影响（截止表述、指令位置等）
2. 提出TCFT（Temporal Critique Fine-Tuning）框架：训练模型对查询、截止时间和候选响应进行时间合规性验证，包括识别泄露、解释边界违规、判断时间可接受性
AI.result: TCFT在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上，分别将平均时间泄露降低41.89和37.79个百分点，显著优于提示工程和标准SFT基线。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程只能引导模型进入时间框架，但无法赋予模型验证响应是否时间合规的能力。TCFT通过训练模型进行批判性时序验证，从根本上解决了时间泄露问题。
idea_en: A temporal cutoff-aware critique fine-tuning (TCFT) framework that trains LLMs to identify post-cutoff information leakage in candidate responses given a query and a cutoff time.
A method for training LLMs to explain temporal boundary violations by generating natural language explanations of why specific information is not knowable before a given cutoff.
A system for temporal admissibility judgment that evaluates whether a response complies with a specified temporal cutoff, rather than relying on prompting alone.

A prompt-level intervention analysis framework revealing that prefix constraints reduce temporal leakage more effectively than suffix constraints, and explicit cutoff statements outperform implicit historical framings.
A training paradigm that treats ex-ante correctness not as an intrinsic property of an answer but as a relation between the answer and the cutoff, enabling cutoff-aware temporal verification.
idea_ch: 一种时间截止点感知的批判微调框架（TCFT），训练LLM在给定查询和截止时间的情况下，识别候选响应中的事后信息泄露
一种训练LLM生成自然语言解释的方法，用于说明特定信息为何在给定截止时间之前不可知，从而解释时间边界违规
一种时间可接受性判断系统，评估响应是否符合指定的时间截止点，而不是仅依赖提示工程
一种提示层干预分析框架，发现前缀约束比后缀约束更有效地减少时间泄露，且显式截止表述优于隐式历史框架
一种将事前正确性视为答案与截止时间之间的关系而非答案固有属性的训练范式，从而实现截止点感知的时间验证能力

title: MindGap: A Conversational AI Framework for Upstream Neuroplastic Intervention in Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
summary: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) is fundamentally a neuroplastic problem traumatic contact events encode over-reactive neural pathways through Hebbian long-term potentiation, producing hair-triggered amygdala-HPA stress cascades that fire before conscious awareness can intercept them. Existing therapeutic approaches, prolonged exposure, EMDR, cognitive behavioural therapy, operate predominantly downstream of the reactive cascade, teaching patients to tolerate or reframe distress after it has arisen. While clinically valuable, these suppression-based approaches do not produce the upstream pathway dissolution that constitutes lasting structural neural reorganisation. This paper proposes MindGap, a privacy-preserving on-device conversational AI framework that delivers structured neuroplastic rehabilitation for PTSD through the practice of dependent origination, a Buddhist psychological framework that identifies the precise moment between the pre-cognitive affective signal and the reactive elaboration that follows as the site of therapeutic intervention. MindGap guides patients through three progressive layers of observation at this feeling tone gap: noticing the bare affective signal before reactive elaboration, recognising it as self-arising rather than caused by the stimulus, and recognising the conditioned implicit belief beneath the feeling. Each layer corresponds to progressively deeper prefrontal regulatory engagement and progressively deeper long-term depression-mediated weakening of the reactive pathway, producing genuine upstream dissolution rather than downstream suppression. Running entirely on-device with no data egress, MindGap delivers daily calibrated exposure sessions through a fine-tuned lightweight large language model, making it deployable in sensitive clinical and military contexts where cloud-based solutions are not permitted.

AI.tldr: MindGap是一个隐私保护的端侧对话AI框架，通过佛教"缘起"心理学原理，在认知前情感信号与反应性加工之间的"感受间隙"进行三层级神经可塑性干预，实现创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）上游神经通路的真正消解，而非下游症状抑制。
AI.motivation: 现有PTSD疗法（暴露疗法、EMDR、CBT）主要作用于应激反应下游，教患者忍受或重构已产生的 distress，无法实现上游神经通路的真正结构重组。
AI.method: 提出MindGap框架，基于端侧轻量级大语言模型，引导患者在"感受间隙"（feeling tone gap）进行三层观察：1) 觉察原始情感信号；2) 认识到信号自生而非由刺激引起；3) 识别情感背后的条件性隐含信念。每层对应更深的前额叶调控参与和长时程抑制（LTD）介导的反应通路弱化。
AI.result: 提出全端侧部署方案，无数据外泄，可在敏感的临床和军事环境中使用，通过每日校准的暴露会话实现神经可塑性康复。
AI.conclusion: MindGap通过精准定位创伤反应的"感受间隙"并进行分层神经可塑性干预，实现了从下游症状抑制到上游通路消解的范式转变，且具备隐私保护和敏感环境部署能力。
idea_en: A privacy-preserving on-device conversational AI framework for PTSD neuroplastic rehabilitation that operates at the pre-cognitive 'feeling tone gap' between affective signal and reactive elaboration.

A three-layer structured observation protocol for therapeutic intervention at the feeling tone gap: (1) noticing bare affective signal before reactive elaboration, (2) recognizing the signal as self-arising rather than stimulus-caused, (3) recognizing the conditioned implicit belief beneath the feeling.
A fine-tuned lightweight LLM deployed entirely on-device with zero data egress, delivering daily calibrated exposure sessions for PTSD treatment in sensitive clinical and military environments.
A neural pathway dissolution mechanism that leverages long-term depression (LTD) through structured mindfulness interventions at the precise moment of pre-cognitive affective triggering.
A dependent origination-based therapeutic framework translated into an AI-guided digital intervention for targeted neuroplastic reorganization of over-reactive trauma pathways.
